name: android_set_display_config
description: Changes how apps render, to check layouts without another phone: dark mode (nightMode), text size (fontScale), screen density (dpi) and size (WIDTHxHEIGHT). Settings stay until changed; reset: true restores light mode, font scale 1.0, and the physical density and size. Returns the settings now in effect.

nightMode.description: Dark mode on, off, or by time of day.

reset.description: Restore defaults before applying the rest.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
